Under legacy semantics, `"auto"` (the default) resolves to `"multiindex"`, so `flat` is false for all the specified option settings. `create_model` still obtains `sns` through the unchanged `as_index` call and passes that same `sns` to the variable and constraint builders; the new context does not flatten snapshots when `flat` is false. Changes inside builders do not establish a change in the snapshots handed to them.
